statement_en: Colour every natural number with one of two colours. Show that there is an infinite set B of positive integers and a single colour such that, for every non-empty finite subset T of B, the sum of the elements of T has that colour.
statement_lean:
theorem erdos_73508 (f : ℕ → Fin 2) :
    ∃ B : Set ℕ, B.Infinite ∧ (∀ m ∈ B, 0 < m) ∧
      ∃ k : Fin 2, ∀ T : Finset ℕ, T.Nonempty → (↑T : Set ℕ) ⊆ B →
        f (∑ m ∈ T, m) = k := by
  sorry
